authority.gateway_id: Persistent engineering_identity.installation from the existing SQLite journal
authority.instance_id: Current process only; never part of a durable cursor or conversation identity
authority.principal_id: Resolved by the existing authenticated Admission middleware; never a client-selected identity
authority.queue_position: Nullable; absence means no measured rank is available
authority.history: New admitted conversation messages are durable; legacy projections explicitly report incomplete history
authority.original_source: source_branch and source_sha retain the admitted repository selection; working_branch identifies the exact or derived implementation target. Engineering base is the original request base ref and is additive metadata, never inferred from the default or source branch. Ordinary or older snapshots can omit base or return null. Provider execution_binding remains byte-identical to the admitted provider binding.

parts.content_sha256: SHA-256 of complete logical message UTF-8 content
parts.assembly: Do not project a final logical message until every part is retained in order and its whole digest matches. A repeated physical sequence must match its previously stored identity and content.
parts.cursor: Advances over stable physical sequence numbers. Terminal/empty pages retain a usable cursor for later appends.
parts.history: Explicit gap=true and missing_ranges when retained physical sequence coverage is incomplete. No silent content truncation.

gap_details.semantics: Sorted nonoverlapping missing physical sequence intervals observed in this page or its terminal tail. They must exactly cover any gaps the receiver accepts; no undeclared sequence jump is valid. A terminal gap cursor advances to latest_sequence. The conversation remains history_complete=false on later snapshots and empty tails.

POST /v1/gateway/engineering/jobs.idempotency: request_id is the durable command identity. Repeating its exact payload returns the original job; a different payload conflicts.
POST /v1/gateway/engineering/jobs.branch_semantics: Read/plan retain the selected source. Explicit implement with branch==base requires source_sha and derives an owned work ref rooted at that exact source. Explicit branch!=base retains the authorized target. No default-branch substitution.

POST /v1/gateway/conversations/{conversa.semantics: Explicit revision-fenced engineering follow-up at a paused/input/terminal checkpoint, preserving original provider/source binding; no inferred scope upgrade. Read/plan can inspect the preceding confirmed working head. Implement requires the working ref still matches that head.
POST /v1/gateway/conversations/{conversa.job: Full established engineering public snapshot with id, chat_id, created_at, deadline and all continuity fields; not a catalog-only item.

GET /v1/gateway/commands/{command_id}.semantics: Read-only lost-response reconciliation within the authenticated principal; unknown command is HTTP 404
GET /v1/gateway/commands/{command_id}.job: Full established engineering public snapshot with id, chat_id, created_at, deadline and all continuity fields; not a catalog-only item.

restart_policy.ordinary: Retain final results and validated client-tool waits; mark interrupted active or queued work without replaying model or tool effects
restart_policy.engineering: Resume the existing durable supervisor and reconcile uncertain mutations under its current lease and receipt rules

ordinary_profile_headers.X-Gateway-Profile-Name-Base64: Negotiated presentation metadata only; unpadded base64url UTF-8, 1..1024 decoded bytes, no control characters
ordinary_profile_headers.unknown_original: Missing original metadata stays empty with original_profile_known=false; a reader profile never rebinds history

ordinary_admission: The existing chat-completions admission commits original profile metadata, retention policy and queued state before worker dispatch. Explicit full retention also commits visible input messages; omitted or none retention creates only metadata with an explicit limited-history reason. Worker-owned completion survives HTTP waiter disconnect and cache miss under an exact persisted generation fence. Ordinary catalog actions remain open/cancel/replay of retained history. A subsequent ordinary Send uses its restored history and original profile/model through the established ordinary route; it never receives implicit repository-engineering authority. Unknown legacy profile/model bindings are read-only until the user explicitly selects a new task context.

ordinary_conversation_retention.full: Explicit durable visible conversation history; requires original profile ID. The policy is immutable for an admitted ordinary job and is bound to its retry identity.
ordinary_conversation_retention.none: No additional prompt, reply, tool, status, or task-title text is appended to continuity tables. The metadata-only conversation reports history_complete=false and conversation_retention_disabled. Existing ordinary job/result retention remains unchanged.

mutation_identity_preconditions.required: Both or neither; omitted pair preserves legacy clients.
mutation_identity_preconditions.authority: Compare with the persisted engineering_identity.installation and the principal resolved by Admission. These headers never grant scopes or ownership.
mutation_identity_preconditions.mismatch: HTTP 409 CONTINUITY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH, before admission or mutation. Partial or malformed pairs are HTTP 400 CONTINUITY_IDENTITY_INVALID.
mutation_identity_preconditions.aliases: The corresponding non-/v1 aliases apply the same preconditions.
